_comment: Committed template. A read-only install names its one EVM address (the NEAR Intents account id) as addresses.evm in config.local.json, which is gitignored and merged over this file key by key. A wallet made in the window needs no config at all. Private keys never appear in either: they live at keysPath, default ~/.phosphor/keys.json, outside the working copy.
_skills: Which files in skills/ a connecting agent is told to use. Names only, no .md. Everything in skills/ is installed; only what is listed here is live. Empty means the agent runs on the connect-time rules alone.
